title: epic/router-edge-worker: verify Hono routing and Polar token metering

commercialDetermination.note: Polar's acceptable-use policy restricts marketplaces that sell others' goods or services for a revenue share and subjects AI generation tooling to closer review. Polar is a candidate for Arcanea-owned SaaS metering, not evidence of marketplace royalty settlement. Criteria paid-entitlements and polar-sandbox-e2e remain unverified until a marketplace-capable rail plus seller, rights and refund responsibilities are recorded.
